definitions.explanation: Acting according to one's own will without considering others.

examples.japanese: {勝手|かって}な⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧。
{勝手|かって}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}らないで→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧{勝手|かって}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
{勝手|かって} expresses acting according to one's own will, often selfishly.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {勝手|かって}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (do ~ without permission)
- {勝手|かって}な〜 (selfish ~)
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧{勝手|かって} (self-centered)
- お⟦{好|す}きに→好き：02355_suki⟧{勝手|かって}に (as you like)

MEANINGS:
1. Selfishness: {勝手|かって}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (selfish person)
2. Without permission: {勝手|かって}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (enter without permission)
3. Kitchen area (historical usage): お{勝手|かって}

Note: {勝手|かって}にしろ means "do what you want" (I don't care).
